blocks.text: Have you ever wondered how we can visually represent the relationships between different groups? Venn diagrams are a powerful tool to do just that!

blocks.markdown: Venn diagrams are used to show the relationships between different sets. They consist of circles that overlap to represent the intersection of sets. Each circle represents a set, and the overlap shows the elements common to both sets.

blocks.title: Definition of Venn Diagram
blocks.text: A Venn diagram is a diagram that uses circles to represent the relationships among different sets.

blocks.markdown: In a two-set Venn diagram, we have two circles. The area where the circles overlap represents the intersection of the two sets, denoted as $A \cap B$. The union of the sets, represented by $A \cup B$, includes all elements in either set.

blocks.title: Drawing a Two-Set Venn Diagram
blocks.prompt: Draw a Venn diagram for sets $A$ and $B$ where $A = \{1, 2, 3, 4\}$ and $B = \{3, 4, 5, 6\}$. Shade the region representing $A \cap B$.

steps.text: Draw two overlapping circles and label them $A$ and $B$.
Place the elements $3$ and $4$ in the overlapping region, as they are common to both sets.
Place $1$ and $2$ in the non-overlapping part of circle $A$, and $5$ and $6$ in the non-overlapping part of circle $B$.
Shade the overlapping region to represent $A \cap B$.

blocks.answer: The shaded region in the middle represents $A \cap B = \{3, 4\}$.

blocks.markdown: Now, let's consider a three-set Venn diagram. This diagram has three overlapping circles. It can represent more complex relationships among three sets, such as $A$, $B$, and $C$.

blocks.title: Exam Tip
blocks.text: When translating word problems into Venn diagrams, carefully identify the sets and their relationships before drawing.

points: Venn diagrams visually represent the relationships between sets using overlapping circles.
The intersection $A \cap B$ is the area where circles $A$ and $B$ overlap.
The union $A \cup B$ includes all elements in either set $A$ or $B$.
